releaseNotes: Enhance diagnostics reporting and network analysis features
changelog: Updated `PingStats` data class to include additional metrics: sent, received, and maxJitterMs.
Improved `summarize` function to calculate and return new metrics for ping statistics.
Enhanced `DiagnosticsPdfWriter` to display detailed network information including connection type, internet access, DNS lookup, ping details, jitter, and packet loss.
Modified `DiagnosticsRunner` to gather and report new network link information and transfer statistics for download and upload.
Updated UI components in `DiagnosticsScreen` to present new metrics and improve user experience with detailed sub-values for network diagnostics.
Added unit tests to validate new metrics in `PingStats` and ensure accurate reporting.
Removed unused image assets from the project.
